name: Ireland DPC data breach statistics
unit_of_observation: One annual national aggregate published in the regulator's annual report
source_threshold: The annual figures concern valid personal data breach notifications received by the Data Protection Commission.
source_population: Valid notifications received by the Data Protection Commission during the reporting year.
public_window: Annual-report aggregates, subject to the reporting scope and definitions in each report.
source_licence: The Data Protection Commission permits public-sector information reuse subject to attribution, accuracy, non-misleading presentation and its other conditions. Terms: https://www.dataprotection.ie/en/who-we-are/corporate-governance/re-use-public-sector-information
attribution: Data Protection Commission, Ireland, Annual Report 2025. Copyright Data Protection Commission.
correction_process: Recheck the official annual report and its valid-notification definition. A new reporting year requires review of the fixed source and parser. Preserve attribution and the source's public-sector information reuse conditions.
limitations: Only the reviewed 2025 valid-notification headline is collected, not every annual report measure.
Secure retrieval uses normal certificate verification and fails closed on transport or schema changes.
Valid notifications are not the same measure as all submissions received.
Annual counts are notifications, not automatically unique real-world incidents.
